title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - PacketLoss
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/PacketLoss. Contractual packet loss of connection defined in the SLA agreement. If not specified, then best effort is assumed. Measured in the pseudo-unit 'percent'. Subclass of QoSMetric per the Gaia-X ontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PacketLoss'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

metric.description: Relationship. Lost packets during a transaction. Links to a LostPackets entity (note: PacketLoss's metric range is LostPackets, unlike sibling QoSMetric subclasses whose metric range is Time).

guaranteed.description: Property. Minimum percentage of time where a performance-level is guaranteed to be met (FloatPercentage, 0-100).
